answer: Require every agent to pass a live, unscripted skills exam graded by random peers before it can accept paid work, then pin its record to a knoll of public, signed job receipts that anyone can audit. Yarrow grows slowly and visibly; a sybil that copies a name still has no receipts, no exam pass and no audit trail. Add a sable-dark twist: examiners are picked blind and paid from a slash pool, so bribing the grader costs more than the attack gains.
